findings.title: Initial stop failure or pre-receipt fill never reaches an owned terminal recovery path
findings.detail: Every intent lacking PAPER_PROTECTED re-enters execute_paper. A definitive first-stop HTTP422 leaves phase STOP_DISPATCHED; exact-CID absence subsequently produces UNCERTAIN_STOP_NO_RESEND forever. UNWIND_MS is ignored on this branch, so filled NET remains unprotected through the hard end. If the stop was accepted and fills before PAPER_PROTECTED is saved, recovery instead fails PAPER_POSITION_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH before inspecting that exit; partial fills likewise strand recovery.
findings.narrow_fix: Persist definitive initial-stop rejection separately from unknown send; validate the exact owned terminal entry and pending ledger, then use the existing scoped quantity-bound PAPER kill helper for confirmed failed protection. Journal unwind dispatch before POST and GET-recover the same CID. Reconcile accepted initial stop terminal/partial fills and cancellation overlap before any remaining-quantity exit. Never fabricate PAPER_PROTECTED, resend an unknown POST, or blind-sell against an unresolved stop; unknown ownership must remain an explicit owner-action blocker with exact-CID polling.
findings.verification: Offline real execute_paper + guard_once synthetic reproductions: stop422 => UNCERTAIN_STOP_NO_RESEND both after window and after UNWIND_MS, NET remaining true; lost stop response/stop fully filled => PAPER_POSITION_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH at both times; unknown stop => UNCERTAIN_STOP_NO_RESEND, NET remaining true. Existing76 tests pass and do not exercise this guard branch.

findings.title: Guard waits five minutes before recovering an already accepted entry
findings.detail: The opener can persist/send a BUY at13:30 and return immediately on a lost response, leaving a real accepted fill without a stop. Guard intentionally performs no recovery until13:35. The original shared lock already prevents overlap with a still-running opener; the unconditional sleep adds up to five minutes of avoidable unprotected exposure.
findings.narrow_fix: Begin guard observation at opening and recover an existing persisted dispatch as soon as the original shared lock is available. During the opening window do not terminate merely because no reservation/invocation exists yet; require authoritative opener terminal evidence or closed window. Keep no-BUY enforcement, exact plan membership, one original lock and no restart/resend. Add targeted accepted-entry/lost-response and lock-overlap/no-premature-exit tests.
findings.verification: Control-flow review; existing test_accepted_entry_with_lost_response_recovers_same_fill_without_second_buy demonstrates recoverable accepted-entry state. No runtime or broker timing measured.
